notes: Names printed without suffix kept bare: MISTLETOE, WALLACE; RUDOLPH AV., NEFF AV., KINEON AV., STATE AV., MAXWELL PL. Mistletoe is two separate pieces: Rudolph Avenue to Neff Avenue, and Kineon/Maxwell to State Avenue. Between Neff and Kineon a 40 ft strip lies on the same line but is closed at both ends (Neff east line and Kineon west line are drawn unbroken), so Neff/Mistletoe is a T from the west and Kineon/Mistletoe a T from the east. The N-S street west of State Avenue is KINEON AV. north of Mistletoe and MAXWELL PL. south of it (same street line, west line unbroken); the junction is recorded twice at the same point, once under each name. Maxwell Place then turns west (L) to a T at Neff Avenue. Wallace comes in from sheet 493 at the top right (30 ft), turns west and meets State Avenue in a T. The 'Drive' through the Hill & Griffith Co. grounds is a private drive, not picked. Nothing named east of State Avenue besides Wallace (Standard Oil yard, C.H.& D.R.R.). Rudolph Avenue's lines stop short of the top edge in the overlap with 493. The unnamed 40 ft cross street between Neff and Kineon on sheet 493 lies above this sheet's top edge.
